articles.headline: Toyota says factory modernization could cost 1 trillion yen a year from 2028
articles.summary: Toyota estimated that modernizing its factories with more automation and robotics could cost 1 trillion yen annually starting in 2028. The scale of spending signals continued capital demand for industrial automation vendors and may influence supplier planning across manufacturing and logistics.

articles.headline: UiPath updates Integration Service for agent-ready connectivity
articles.summary: UiPath said its Integration Service now acts as an agent-ready layer for credentials, actions, and event sources, making it easier for coding agents and robots to connect to enterprise systems. For businesses, that can lower integration friction, improve automation reliability, and speed deployment across ERP, CRM, ITSM, and legacy tools.

articles.headline: AI agents are reshaping enterprise software economics
articles.summary: Enterprise software vendors are increasingly embedding AI agents that execute workflows, not just assist with them, changing how companies buy and deploy software. This shift could alter SaaS pricing, reduce some manual work, and force managers to rethink automation, integration, and vendor strategy.
